params.name: document
params.description: Document (created by SAVE VARIABLES) to load variables from; pass an empty string to show the standard Open File dialog.

params.name: variable
params.description: Variable to receive a loaded value; created if it doesn't already exist, overwritten if it does.

members.name: variable
members.description: Additional variable to receive a loaded value.

overloads.semanticRole: Loads one or more variables (created or overwritten) from a document previously written by SAVE VARIABLES.

constraints: The document must have been created using SAVE VARIABLES.
In compiled databases, each variable must be of the same type as the one saved to disk.
